senses.gloss: f. (cmp. קֶלֶת) masonry under a stationary stove, fire place under a portable stove.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 7:1">Kel. VII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 5:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. V, 5</cite>.—*Pl. <he>קַלְתּוֹתִים</he>.
Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ top ברחו לתוך ק׳ של בה״מ וכ׳ they fled into the fire places (stoves) of the Temple, and they were all burned &c. (comment.: chambers).
